subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psdisptev:psSetupTev
subjects.behavior: Requires readable word1 and writable word1 in normalizing modes. Masks 0x80100480, returns on cache equality, otherwise stores key and dispatches all16 possible combinations. Four untextured bit0x80 cases clear that bit in input and cache. Programs 1..3 TEV stages and0..1 texture generators; common stage operations and external color registers are separate prerequisites.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psdisptev:psSetupTevCommon
subjects.behavior: Unconditionally configures stages 0..2 order, add/zero-bias/scale1/clamped operations writing PREV, and swap0 selectors. Does not set stage counts, texgen counts, color/alpha inputs, register values or cache.

subjects.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psdisptev:psSetupTevInvalidState
subjects.behavior: Writes UINT32_MAX to prevTev[0], forcing the next valid masked request to miss. No GX writes and no second-element access.
